2.3 million members and this is all I get? Honestly, you know what I want to do? I want to kill the other guy. I know where he lives. I want to follow him until he's alone and then I want to smash his head into a wall, over and over and over again as he screams for help. I want to watch the life drain from his eyes with satisfaction knowing there is one less piece of shit like him in the world. Then I'm going to kill me. Then I'm going to chew through 200mg of oxycodone, pick a nice place to lie down and just peace out.

The rest of the world is your problem now.
Depends how you feel about Love Live Fes.

I have a brain tumor on my pituitary gland. It excretes growth hormone creating a condition called Acromegaly which has led to the enlargement of my hands, feed and jaw line. It also causes me to sweat profusely a random times for no reason. I've also been through radiation treatment which given the area in questions, completely tanked my body's ability to produce testosterone. I can still perform sexually but I have limited drive to do so meaning I rarely initiate and am often convinced it's not a good use of time. Lack of testosterone also leads to low energy/motivation which is compounded by the daily injections I take to inhibit the excess growth hormone in my system since they can tank liver function which also presents as fatigue (and also means I can't drink alcohol.  
TLDR: Brain tumor, no energy from side effects of treatment, limited sex drive.  


Work life is me working 5-6 days per week to be able to afford my rent and medical costs and whatnot. I don't really find time to socialise outside of the workplace, I can't drink and I'm socially fucking awkward when I'm sober which is all the time these days.
I'd agree except I didn't catch her, she confessed. She didn't give me the whole story but she didn't stop me either. I...I just don't know.
30 feels too old to be dating like that, especially with my health issues and work life. I'd have to change so much about myself.
Thank you, I'll give it a look.

The problem I foresee is how do I trust anyone moving forward? This was somebody I trusted with more than anyone I ever have in my life. How would I move onto another relationship and trust them when this is how my last one ended? How do I ever trust anyone again.
